pages.text: $(thing)Slurry$() is manure mixed with water. Animals leave dung on the ground in layers: $(thing)shovel$() it up, then craft four manure with a water bucket into a $(thing)Bucket of Slurry$().

Pour slurry on farmland for one dose on every block of a 3x3 patch, or load buckets into the fertiliser spreader (nine doses each). It supplies nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and organic matter.$(br2)Dung left lying slowly rots into the ground beneath it.
$(thing)Compost$() is slower and gentler. It builds organic matter and supplies balanced nutrients.
$(thing)Bone meal$() is a phosphorus and calcium fertiliser here. It no longer makes crops grow instantly (configurable).
$(thing)Wood Ash$(), from burning sticks, adds potassium and calcium and raises pH.
Right-click farmland (or a crop on it) with an amendment to spread one dose per block. Alfalfa and clover hay work as $(thing)green manure$(): nitrogen-rich residue for the next crop.
